minutes_text:
Beverly Hills City Council Liaison / Central Business Security Committee
  Special Closed Session Meeting

  CITY OF BEVERLY HILLS
  455 N. Rexford Drive
  4th Floor Conference Room A
  Beverly Hills, CA 90210

  Tuesday, May 12, 2026
  3:30 PM

  MINUTES

1) Public Comment
  a. Members of the public will be given the opportunity to directly address the
  Committee on any item listed on the agenda.

  Steve Mayer

2) Discuss Safety and Hospitality Services

  Staff and Council Liaisons discussed various options for safety and hospitality services,
  budgets and scope of work for contract services, and implementation of upcoming
  changes to security staffing in the business triangle.

3) City Hall Security

  Staff provided Council Liaisons with an update to City Hall security personnel changes.

4) Future Agenda Items

  Staff will return to Council Liaisons in a future meeting to discuss supplemental security
  options for large-scale events and alternative security coverage on an as-needed basis.

5) Adjournment

  Meeting was adjourned at 4:34pm.
